nodes.summary: The number of ordered pairs of distinct haplotypes of `C` whose core alleles (under `core`) agree and whose windows of radius `d` agree. The extended haplotype includes the core, so pairs carrying different core alleles are never concordant, even when their outward windows match.
nodes.title: Concordant haplotype pairs sharing a core allele

nodes.summary: The number of ordered pairs of distinct haplotypes of `C` whose windows of radius `d` agree.
nodes.title: Concordant haplotype pairs at a given radius

nodes.summary: EHH is nonincreasing in the radius: widening the window can only break ties.
nodes.title: EHH is nonincreasing in the radius

nodes.summary: Extended haplotype homozygosity with core-allele labels: the probability that two distinct haplotypes drawn from `C` without replacement share both their core allele and their window of radius `d`. For a set `C` of carriers of a single core allele this is the same count as `ehh`; for a pooled set `D` carrying several core alleles it excludes the cross-core pairs that plain `ehh` would wrongly count as concordant.
nodes.title: Extended haplotype homozygosity with core-allele labels

nodes.summary: EHH as the sampling-without-replacement homozygosity of the partition of `C` into window types: `EHH(d) = ∑_t c_t (c_t - 1) / (#C (#C - 1))`, where `c_t` is the number of haplotypes of `C` with window `t`. This is the form in which EHH is usually defined.
nodes.title: EHH as homozygosity of window-type counts

nodes.summary: Outside the domain `2 ≤ #C` the definition returns the junk value `0`.
nodes.title: EHH is zero for a set of at most one haplotype

nodes.summary: At radius `0` every pair of haplotypes agrees, so `EHH(0) = 1`.
nodes.title: EHH at radius zero equals one

nodes.summary: Extended haplotype homozygosity at radius `d` of the haplotype set `C`: the probability that two distinct haplotypes drawn from `C` without replacement agree at all `d` sites nearest the core (Sabeti et al. 2002). For `#C ≤ 1` the denominator vanishes and the junk value `0` is returned; every statement below that needs the probabilistic reading assumes `2 ≤ #C`.
nodes.title: Extended haplotype homozygosity (EHH)

nodes.summary: Averaging over the pair coalescence time `T₂`, which is exponential of rate `1` in units of `2N` generations under the neutral coalescent, the probability that no recombination falls on the pair's genealogy within distance `d` is `1 / (1 + ρ d)`. In a mutation-free model, since a recombined lineage can still carry an identical haplotype, this is a lower bound for `E[EHH(d)]`; without that assumption the bound is…
nodes.title: Mean no-recombination probability under the neutral coalescent

nodes.summary: With a positive reference EHH, the relative EHH exceeds `1` exactly when the core allele's haplotypes are the more homozygous ones.
nodes.title: Criterion for relative EHH to exceed one

nodes.summary: The no-recombination probability decays in the distance from the core.
nodes.title: No-recombination probability decays with distance

nodes.summary: The probability that no recombination falls on the genealogy of a pair of lineages within genetic distance `d` of the core, given that the pair coalesces at time `t` (time in units of `2N` generations, `ρ = 4Nr` the scaled recombination rate per site): the two lineages carry recombination events at total rate `ρ * d` until they coalesce.
nodes.title: Probability of no recombination on a pair's genealogy

nodes.summary: Relative extended haplotype homozygosity: the core-labelled EHH of the core-allele carriers `C` divided by the core-labelled EHH of the pooled set `D` of haplotypes carrying the other core alleles. The denominator counts only pairs sharing a core allele, so cross-core pairs never inflate it. This is the statistic of the long-range haplotype test (Sabeti et al. 2002). It is a junk value `0` when the denominator…
nodes.title: Relative extended haplotype homozygosity (REHH)

nodes.summary: Two haplotypes have the same window of radius `d` exactly when they agree at every site `k < d`.
nodes.title: Equality of haplotype windows

nodes.summary: The window of radius `d` of haplotype `i`: its alleles at the `d` sites closest to the core, in the direction indexed by `ℕ`.
nodes.title: Haplotype window around the core

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
